**Logo Badge Description:**
The logo consists of a circular badge containing a stylized, uppercase letter **"M"**. The circle has a **faceted, 3D geometric style** (resembling a low-poly or crystalline structure) with distinct color segments: **bright cyan/blue** on the left side transitioning to **vibrant purple/magenta** on the right side. The "M" itself is white and appears to be integrated into or overlaid on this faceted background, creating a modern, tech-focused aesthetic with a subtle gradient effect across the polygonal facets.
